definitions.units: Uncalibrated model time T and model length units; not seconds/metres
definitions.last_gannet_launch_T: Last realised transition with reason launch, including aerial plunges that never enter water
definitions.last_gannet_water_entry_T: Last committed plunge-to-pursuit transition with reason water_entry; uncommitted water entry is excluded
definitions.last_gannet_capture_T: Last oral event with status captured, counted once rather than also counting its transition
definitions.last_gannet_bout_end_T: Last transition from plunge/pursuit to a non-attack mode; an unfinished final attack has no invented end
definitions.no_launch_final_6T: No realised gannet launch in the final 6T; descriptive gap, not evidence of permanent cessation
definitions.no_launch_final_10T: No realised gannet launch in the final 10T; descriptive gap, not evidence of permanent cessation
definitions.accessibility: New-target gate only: underwater live fish within sense radius and detection depth, depth <= max_dive_depth - speed/turn_rate - ascent_margin, and (horizontal distance + positive air height)/air_speed + depth/speed <= bout_duration
definitions.depth_blackouts: Sampled intervals with living fish but zero within the operative depth cap/detection depth, independent of bird distance; saved 0.1T frames held left-constant, interval boundaries uncertain by one sample
definitions.all_birds_final_search: All birds are in physical search mode in the final saved frame; does not mean deleted or intentionally abandoning prey
definitions.final_shallow_but_out_of_reach: Live fish pass the operative depth cap, but all birds have zero new-target eligibility after distance/travel checks; independent of physical bird modes
definitions.terminal_evidence: Description at the 36T observation boundary, not a prediction of what would happen in a longer simulation
definitions.temporary_launch_gaps_6T: Consecutive aggregate gannet launch times separated by >=6T, followed by a realised launch; excludes the unfinished terminal gap
definitions.replication: 48 G-bearing cells: 36 mixed and 12 G-only over four previously observed schools; cells share school/control data and are not 48 independent replicates
definitions.individual_scope: 160 saved bird trajectories (120 mixed, 40 G-only), not 160 independent experimental units; per-bird endpoint search differs from an entire flock losing access
